tradesSection.headline: Find the work
tradesSection.lede: Explore the trade areas shaping our educational vision. Select a field to see its foundations and a sample immersive learning experience.
tradesSection.note: Learning experiences shown are **illustrative curriculum concepts**, not a catalog of currently available courses or certifications.

trades.name: Welding
trades.title: Join materials. Build possibility.
trades.desc: Explore the science, preparation, and precision behind strong metal connections. Learn how process, technique, and inspection work together.
trades.goal: Recognize common joint types and explain the purpose of joint preparation.
trades.sample: Explore a virtual welding workstation. Identify components, select the appropriate protective equipment, and explain the sequence for preparing a joint.

image.alt: A welding student in a protective helmet and leather gloves welding a steel frame in a training shop, sparks coming off the arc

trades.name: HVAC
trades.title: Understand the systems behind comfort.
trades.desc: Explore heating, ventilation, and air conditioning through the relationships between airflow, heat transfer, and system components.
trades.goal: Identify major HVAC components and describe their roles in a system.
trades.sample: Trace airflow through a virtual system, identify major components, and explain how each contributes to indoor comfort.

trades.name: Electrical
trades.title: Make the connection.
trades.desc: Build a foundation in circuit concepts, component recognition, diagrams, and safe work awareness before supervised practical instruction.
trades.goal: Read a basic circuit diagram and identify its main components.
trades.sample: Explore a de-energized virtual circuit and trace the relationship between a source, protective device, switch, and load.

trades.name: Manufacturing
trades.title: From an idea to a working process.
trades.desc: Explore how materials, machines, measurement, and people come together to produce consistent work.
trades.goal: Describe a production sequence and identify where quality checks belong.
trades.sample: Walk through a virtual production sequence, identify inspection points, and explain how a measurement affects the next step.

image.alt: Hands checking a welded test coupon marked 3F SMAW against a gauge, with more finished coupons laid out on the steel bench

trades.name: Construction
trades.title: Shape the spaces around us.
trades.desc: Discover the craftsmanship behind carpentry, masonry, and building systems. Connect plans and measurement to materials and assembly.
trades.goal: Interpret basic plan dimensions and explain an assembly sequence.
trades.sample: Review a virtual room plan, identify dimensions and materials, and organize a basic assembly sequence for instructor discussion.

image.alt: Students in hard hats laying concrete block in an outdoor masonry training yard

trades.name: Emerging technology
trades.title: Build skills for what comes next.
trades.desc: Explore the connections between skilled trades, robotics, drones, and digital systems, with an emphasis on foundational understanding.
trades.goal: Explain how sensors and digital tools can support a technician's work.
trades.sample: Explore a virtual inspection scenario, identify what information a sensor could collect, and discuss how a technician would use it.

image.alt: Two students kneeling beside a humanoid robot and several wheeled rover robots on the floor of a technology lab
